parameters.name: MaxResult
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Default value: 50. Maximum value: 1000.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that is used to start the next query.

parameters.name: PolicyId
parameters.description: The ID of the tag policy.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. Set the value to cn-shanghai.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun tag list-targets-for-policy --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --max-result 50 --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a0000 --policy-id p-de62a0bf400e4b690000 --region cn-hangzhou
